svg.title: Intensity patterns of a double slit and a grating
svg.desc: (a) The double slit gives broad maxima of equal height at m = 0 and m = ±1. (b) A grating with the same slit spacing has its principal maxima at the same angles, but they are much narrower and sharper, with small secondary maxima between them. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: More slits sharpen the principal grating maxima
Same spacing d; more illuminated slits
N steps through 2, 4, 8, 16 at fixed d and λ. Ideal narrow slits; each curve is normalized to its own
peak. Maxima stay at integer d sin θ/λ.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
